notes: Queue uses manufacturer storefront publication proxies newest-to-oldest where no exact day of hardware release is supported. Proxy dates are not retail launch dates; selected later hardware drawing revisions do not rewrite original product dates.

All device behavior is driven by physical board mappings and existing MMIO GPIO/SPI/I2C/RMT/SDMMC transports. No CPU, shared bus, hot scheduling, factory stubs or host-framebuffer writes are added by this batch.

Shared SSD1306 controller is from 6a56901b77a0324f1506ff580de3135fdb4d93d8; these board tests exercise actual S3 I2C routing. Generic product names never silently attach optional shields or sibling chips.

Firmware binaries were only discovered in exact official trees, not downloaded or mirrored. Blob SHA-1/size are repository metadata, not fetched SHA-256; factory identity and documented flash offset are explicit per candidate. Full startup/layout remains unverified.

Raw public source bodies are reproducible from pinned URLs and hashes; archiveName identifies the local audit cache, not a promise that upstream source bodies are vendored. No private captures, user data, credentials or device serials are retained.
